# C05 — Immutable Gap

## #0

The Immutable Gap is the non-coincidence between a determination and its determining condition. Representing that condition makes another determination; the present act of representing has not become the object it presents. “Immutable” names the recurrence of this relation through enlargement. Descriptions, instruments and lives can change while the relation recurs in their changed activity.

A [formal permission](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#limit-and-recurring-gap) can change. Restricting an inconsistent collecting rule genuinely repairs that construction; the act making the repair still has conditions which a further account can represent. The recurrent gap concerns this act/content relation through successful enlargement. Each mathematical limit retains the hypotheses under which its particular result holds; recurrent non-coincidence supplies no theorem that every closed system is incomplete.

A [limit of determination](C04-Formal-Limit.md) arises where an account encounters what its present operation cannot settle. Enlarging the operation can settle that question while bringing the enlarged act's own conditions into play. What recurs is the difference between the achieved determination and its present determining activity. The [copula](C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) gives that difference a relation: the terms can answer to one another through the distinction they retain. Non-coincidence permits their meeting.

## #1

A self-portrait is an exact initial test. It can disclose something true of the person making it; a portrait of the act of portraiture can disclose more. Neither contains the present seeing through which it becomes a portrait. The difference survives the additional representation, without rendering the representation worthless.

[Faithful first-person definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) turns upon the defining act itself. A predicate presents something determinate; the present fact that it is known is already active in presenting it. A further predicate can make an earlier activity available to inspection, but its current apprehension is again an act. The Subject can recognise itself from within this activity. Its [defined indefinability](C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) distinguishes that positive recognition from possession of an exhaustive self-object.

## #2

The gap relocates when the frame enlarges. What stood outside the first account can become explicit within the second. The second account then occurs through its own language, selection and situated attention. An inventory can disclose all the prior conditions admitted to it while its present use remains a further determining act.

Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|eightfold traversal]] begins with the parent relation `/ = −/−`: relating is available before its terms have been assigned. In `0/1`, awareness and appearing phenomenon are one conscious circumstance; awareness becomes readable through appearing without becoming another mark. `?/!` gives that circumstance question and assertion: asking already takes a provisional mark, while asserting remains answerable to what called for it. `−/+` gives the relation force as withdrawal and extension, a co-present pulse. `X/x` makes that force recognisable as a determining capacity and its recurring local instance. `AM/IS` lives the relation as first-person presence and third-person sayability meeting through second-person address, in a world of body, concern, speech and memory. `∞/dx` makes a minute local difference exact in its relation to an inexhaustible horizon. The achieved determination then returns through `1/0` toward the ground it presupposes: recognition renews the act whose foundation it cannot acquire as an object.

The [parent, six determinations and return](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) are one traversal with distinct operations. The parent and return bracket the sixfold rather than adding positions to its count. Each exact instance discloses its capacity; each assertion keeps its question available; each account of a context is itself lived in a context. The gap persists within these real relations as their act/content difference.

## #3

The meta-sign makes this non-coincidence writable. `0` is a determinate glyph with an unusual office: it marks the condition that cannot enter the account as one more ordinary object. Its written form is available; what it marks is not thereby possessed. A represented empty set, by contrast, is a perfectly determinate mathematical object. Confusing those offices would make the symbol's availability refute the relation it was introduced to disclose.

The [crossed-zero recognition](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) traverses `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1`, returning to `0/1`. In `Ø`, the instrument's slash is fused with the apparent self and occludes the ground it presupposes. In `X`, the same discriminating activity cuts and names an object-field; its self-effect and world-effect can appear independent while their mediation remains hidden. `Ø/X` makes the slash visible between them. In `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`, recognition operates on both sides together: unoccluded presence relates to the occluded self, and unity relates to the cut field. Their outer relation makes the whole architecture available to recognition. `1` affirms the integrated Self and includes the differentiated field. The return to `0/1` recognises the pulse through which manifestation takes form.

The stroke crossing the zero does not fill it. What changes is the lived availability of mediation: an instrument mistaken for the self becomes a recognised means, and an apparently independent object-world is received within the whole relation. Recognition retains the distinctions it integrates. The present recognising act remains distinct from what it has made explicit.

## #4

The lived consequence is more intimate than an observer remaining outside every picture. Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust|trust revision]] relates the self's inability to coincide exhaustively with its image to a life in which relations actually meet. An encounter can alter the self in a way its prior account could not produce. The recurring gap keeps the account answerable to that real meeting.

[Another person's answer](../A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) can correct what I took them to mean or expose a failure in the terms of my approach. Their inclusion within a shared whole preserves their independent reply, withdrawal and refusal. A revised account receives this reply instead of taking their belonging as possession. A [return on a covering space](../A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) preserves a different relation: a locally returning path can retain its travelled displacement in the covering description. That mathematical result holds through its own construction and proof. The lived Subject's non-coincidence concerns present apprehension and represented content, rather than identifying the Subject with a topological hole.

## #5→0

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../../symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) gives the approachable limit to investigation and the absolute limit to faith. Investigation determines its undertaking up to the limit of determination; faith continues a relation whose limit is never to be determined. Inquiry can achieve real gains, and an answerable commitment can act through them, while their present enactment exceeds the account that guided it.

[Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) makes mediation articulate in the next encounter. An account can expose its position and receive a challenge to its result, source, rule or permission. A warranted correction reaches the condition actually implicated; an adequate condition can be retained with reasons. The next act inherits the returned judgment and its grounds. Transparency is this active availability for return within the relation being lived.

A reader comparing an account with its source occupies a local functional knowing centre: the account is known, and retained passages, comparison rules and reports are its means. Within the person's containing inquiry, that reading apparatus itself serves as means. Inspecting it makes an earlier determining centre known in a further act; the present first-person condition remains active through the inspection. The recurrent gap preserves these relative offices as well as their containing Life.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|relation of Symbol, Account and Trust]] carries the return through four operations. A symbol discloses its source; an account preserves its dependence on that source; trust carries the finite account into committed action; the account's effects re-enter the field of a later account. Source, exclusions and conditions remain available to correction, reply and refusal through this circulation. A [faithful definition](C02-Faithful-Definition.md) retains the act from which its predicates took their warrant. An [integral zero](../A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) lets the exact sign return as living Symbol: its achieved determination joins what it cannot enclose and renews the relation through which another determination becomes possible.
